title: macOS watcher display-path aliases can hide a change inside a canonical named source root
outcome: A watcher event inside a named source root remains attributed to that root when macOS presents /var and /private/var spellings, including another session's scope and a missing closing basis.
acceptance: Before source execution, record Greg's authorization lifting the applicable 2026-10-24 product STOP for this change.

Preserve the existing cross-session named-root watcher regression, with canonical named-root identity and realistic watcher scopes/events, and prove alias-equivalent events count exactly once while outside-root events do not count; do not skip or weaken the regression.

Use consistent path representations at the existing watcher attribution and closing-observation boundaries without adding filesystem I/O under StateInner, changing identity authority or broadly relaxing path fences; obtain the standard review and exact-input checks before landing.
